body:
I’ll be in your beautiful country the first half of October – in Canberra, Adelaide, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Sydney. (I’ll also be in Aukland, NZ, October 12-14. Details TBA) Information here … and after the jump:

Where faith meets the world: An evening with Brian McLaren

Start: Monday, October 05, 2009 – Finish: Thursday, October 08, 2009

Contact:

03 9287 2092 | church@worldvision.com.au

Where: Canberra, Melbourne, Adelaide and Brisbane, AUSTRALIA

In October 2009, World Vision will proudly host well-known author, speaker and pastor Brian McLaren. In 2005, Time magazine listed Brian as one of America’s most influential evangelicals.

Brian has taken a strong interest in the work of World Vision over many years and is a passionate advocate of our work. While in Australia he will speak about a range of issues. His talks will address such themes as when mission meets the world; poverty, the environment; and the spiritual crisis facing the world.

In a time where everyone is talking about the global financial crisis, Brian McLaren is also talking about Jesus, his message for us and our situation. Brian offers a framework in which we can explore our societal systems – those of prosperity, equity and security.

Brian will be supported by Melbourne performance poet Cameron Semmens, Cameron’s verbal prowess is deeply provocative and delightful.
